purpose: SEC-DB-RLS-001 I1: the target database identity model. Explicit grants, no default privileges: a table that is not listed here gets no runtime access (fails closed) and the verifier fails CI until it is classified. Nothing in this file is applied to production by I1.

identities.vexa_migrator: owns every object in the public schema and runs migrations (deploy time only); NOSUPERUSER, BYPASSRLS because tables are FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and data-fixing migrations must see every tenant; an owner can disable RLS regardless, so this adds no isolation risk; never held by the runtime path
identities.vexa_runtime: the API; table-level privileges from runtime.tables; owns nothing; no DDL; NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS
identities.vexa_backup: read-only; BYPASSRLS is its only extra attribute, justified solely because pg_dump must read forced-RLS tables; SELECT only
identities.vexa_reporter: read-only operator reports that span tenants (the sellable-SKU audit report and the media-integrity report); NOSUPERUSER; BYPASSRLS only because a report spans tenants; SELECT on the report tables only; owns nothing, no DDL, no writes; its credential must never be reachable by the API process
identities.vexa_ops: operator path: the platform control tables (the kill switch and the platform budget periods) and the sellable-SKU backfill; NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS, so the backfill sets the tenant context itself and iterates tenants; it is never a general cross-tenant writer

noCrossTenantMaintenanceRole: Deliberately not provisioned, and no policy may open on a session setting that the ordinary runtime can set. Cross-tenant jobs that run inside the API use tenant iteration (docs/qa/sec-db-rls-001-call-site-classification-2026-10-06.md section 3, owner decision 2026-10-07 on D-022). A cross-tenant read that cannot iterate runs outside the API as an operator script under the read-only vexa_reporter; a cross-tenant write iterates tenants under vexa_ops. No BYPASSRLS maintenance role is created to preserve a shortcut.

exceptionsToCrud.ai_platform_controls: SELECT only: operators write the kill switch through vexa_ops, never the API
exceptionsToCrud.ai_platform_budget_periods: SELECT and UPDATE only: the API moves counters, operators create and delete periods

ops.note: Product and Variant serve the sellable-SKU backfill (scripts/sellable-sku-variantless-backfill.cjs reads products, reads and creates variants). Both are forced-RLS tables and vexa_ops is NOBYPASSRLS, so the backfill must set the tenant context for each tenant.

reporter.note: The audit report reads connectorSubmission, product and variant (scripts/sellable-sku-variantless-audit-report.cjs); the media-integrity report reads mediaAsset (scripts/media-integrity-readonly-report.cjs). Read-only, across tenants by design.
